headline: Equinor Q3 Operating Profit Doubles, Raises Production Outlook
summary: Equinor reported a surge in third-quarter net income and operating profit, driven by strong refining margins, high oil and gas prices, and increased hydrocarbon production. The Norwegian energy major raised its 2026 oil and gas production growth forecast to around 4%.
why: Equinor is a major international energy company headquartered in Norway, operating globally in oil, gas, and renewable energy production.

impacts.name: Equinor
impacts.why: Higher earnings and production forecasts directly improve the company's financial profile.

why_moved: Stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings and an upgraded production forecast directly boost investor sentiment and valuation expectations for the company.
